Report_ID: OIL-SIF-0001
Date: 2026-01-08
Location: Duliajan
Work_Area: Maintenance
Report_Type: Unsafe Act
Narrative: Working at height without effective fall protection; worker was observed near an open edge while handling tools. The condition had potential for serious injury if the task continued.
Potential_Exposure: Fall from height / dropped object
SIF_Precursor: Fall from height
SIF_Risk: Critical
Immediate_Action: Permit was suspended pending verification of controls.
Potential_Severity: Fatality / Serious Injury
NLP_Label: High SIF Risk

Report_ID: OIL-SIF-0002
Date: 2026-01-11
Location: Bongaigaon
Work_Area: Electrical
Report_Type: Unsafe Condition
Narrative: Technician entered a restricted area near rotating equipment without completing isolation verification. The supervisor was not immediately present at the work location.
Potential_Exposure: Unexpected equipment movement / caught-in
SIF_Precursor: Line of fire
SIF_Risk: Critical
Immediate_Action: Area was barricaded and the task was stopped until corrective measures were completed.
Potential_Severity: Fatality / Serious Injury
NLP_Label: High SIF Risk

Report_ID: OIL-SIF-0003
Date: 2026-01-14
Location: Digboi
Work_Area: Drilling
Report_Type: Near Miss
Narrative: Vehicle reversed in an active work zone without a spotter; personnel were working within the vehicle path. Required exclusion or isolation controls were not effectively maintained.
Potential_Exposure: Vehicle-person interaction
SIF_Precursor: Struck-by / vehicle
SIF_Risk: Critical
Immediate_Action: Equipment was isolated and the condition was escalated to the area in-charge.
Potential_Severity: Fatality / Serious Injury
NLP_Label: High SIF Risk

Report_ID: OIL-SIF-0004
Date: 2026-01-17
Location: Duliajan
Work_Area: Pipeline
Report_Type: Unsafe Act
Narrative: Temporary electrical cable had damaged insulation and was routed through a wet area near personnel access. The observation was made during active work and had immediate exposure potential.
Potential_Exposure: Electric shock / arc flash
SIF_Precursor: Electrical energy
SIF_Risk: High
Immediate_Action: Personnel were moved to a safe location and the hazard was reported for rectification.
Potential_Severity: Fatality / Serious Injury
NLP_Label: High SIF Risk

Report_ID: OIL-SIF-0005
